verdict.rationale: Netlify's AI Gateway lets project code connect to popular AI models without managing API keys, so builders can call models without provisioning GPUs. It is a gateway to third-party providers rather than Netlify-run global edge inference, and the docs give only thin marketing-level mentions. Missing for 10: evidence of globally distributed or edge-run inference, a documented single-call inference API, statements about capacity or scaling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
